question: Which part of the brain switches on every time you dream?
answer: A region at the back of the brain switches on whenever a dream starts. The same region activates in light sleep, deep sleep and REM, which is why researchers call it a real dream switch.
move: Dreams switch on at the back of the brain, in any phase of sleep.
